summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. furnished a Form 6-K attaching its condensed consolidated interim financial statements prepared under IFRS (IAS 34) for the period ended September 30, 2026, together with the independent auditor's review report. No transaction, ownership change, capital action, board recommendation, advisor mandate, or structural term is disclosed; the filing is a routine periodic earnings/interim-reporting submission by a foreign private issuer (the local equivalent of a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q). Watch only for ordinary credit-quality, margin, and capital-ratio trends; there is no deal or risk-arb angle.
